summary: Iteration 5: focused on the new Drainage plan tab, plus regression checks of ICF, Waterproofing, Crew packets, Reports and Photos. Backend: 16/16 in the new test_iter5_drainage.py passed. It made real Gemini calls for drainage and crew_waterproofing on TEST_Iter4 Set, ran PATCH checks (including 404 for a bad index or another tool, and 422), and checked the crew and full PDFs. iter4 fast regression: 14 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend on Smith: the Drainage tab shows strategy, summary, filter chips with correct counts (All 11 / Missing 9 / Specified 2 / Unclear 0), quantities on all 11 items, sequence, inspections and RFIs. Verify persists after reload and is kept separate from the Waterproofing list. ICF: icf-zero-warning is now present. Setting height 0 to 8 on IW1 recalculated to 51 straight / 12 corner / 8.53 yd³ (hand-checked correct), then restored. Report dialog: the Foundation crew prepare flow went prepare, running, ready and downloaded a 12-page PDF with the FOUNDATION CREW PACKET title, briefing, ICF, Waterproofing and Drainage plan sections, and the header now reads 'Foundation Crew Packet'. Photos on the TEST project: upload, analyzing, analysis with issues and fix steps, follow-up answered in photo-thread-0, then delete. All worked with no page errors.

minor.endpoint: POST /api/projects/{id}/report (wp_section, used by Waterproofing AND Drainage)
minor.issue: Still not fixed from iter4. Unverified items use the glyph U+2610, which Helvetica lacks, so it renders as a filled black square that looks 'checked' (confirmed by rendering page 7 of the foundation packet). 'MEDIUM' wraps to 'MEDIU M' in the 0.55in Sev column.

Still no guard against starting a tool while it is already running (duplicate Gemini jobs). Re-running waterproofing or drainage resets every 'verified' flag to False with no warning, so on-site verification work is lost.
Unchanged: a failed follow-up sets the whole photo to status 'failed' even though the analysis is still valid.

ui_bugs.issue: Double numbering, e.g. '1. 1. Install erosion control...'. The AI returns already-numbered strings and Steps adds its own index. Strip a leading '^\d+[.)]\s*' or tell the prompt not to number.

issues: WpBody is reused, so the drainage list also has data-testid='waterproofing-checklist' and 'wp-*' test ids (works, but is ambiguous).
The re-read button gives no confirm/warning that verified checks will be cleared.
Five tabs now scroll horizontally. 'Sheets'/'ICF' are scrolled off-screen with no scroll cue (acceptable, but a fade or arrow would help).

action_items: report.py wp_section: replace the U+2610/U+2713 glyphs with Helvetica-safe text ('[ ]'/'[x]' or 'No'/'Yes'), or register a DejaVu TTF font; widen the Sev column (0.55 to about 0.7in) so 'MEDIUM' does not wrap
DrainagePlan Steps: strip leading numbers from AI items (or adjust DRAIN_PROMPT) to avoid '1. 1.'
run_tool for checklists: carry 'verified' forward by matching category+item on re-run, or warn before re-reading; return 409 if the tool is already running
run_photo: when a follow-up fails, keep status 'ready' and set a thread error instead
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 776 lines (>700). Split the tools/photos/report routes into routers.
start_tool checks the tool name only after get_project, so an unknown project with an unknown tool returns a project 404. That is fine, just noting it.
The crew report sheet filter `str(n).isdigit() or isinstance(n, int)` can let a negative int through as index -2. This is harmless since no page matches.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all specified flows work; only cosmetic issues)
